reviews.texto: Andy and the guys did a great job. They came when they said they would come. They did what they said they would do. And the price was what they said it would be. What else can you ask for?

Wolf did extensive tiling work for us to replace poorly installed tile flooring and shower, they were working on a tight deadline but got everything done while we were away. Floors and shower look amazing! Will definitely call Wolf for our next project!

The whole Wolf team did an awesome job transforming my existing garage into a beautiful functional living space and extension of my kitchen area. It was exactly what I had envisioned. I am very happy with the results and would gladly recommend and hire them again!

Julio Rosa and his crew delivered impeccable service and quality workmanship from the start of our project through the project's completion. We were building out a brand new commercial space for a new family business, and were faced with many decisions along the way. Julio and his team shared expert advice and wisdom gained through their vast experience, to consult and advise in a way that guided us through those decisions, to the best possible outcome. We are delighted with how the space turned out, and are excited for our big opening day!

Wolf Carpentry services does excellent work- interior and exterior. The carpentry, siding, painting, everything is tight. I adore Julio, Mauricio, frankly- there hasn’t been one person from Wolf who hasn’t been lovely and excellent at their job. Julio is fussy, which you can see in his estimates- they are precise and fair. Julio was also willing to do phased restoration on my Victorian, so I wasn’t stuck eating peanut butter or taking out equity on my house. I love them, we have an annual house date every spring.

Julio and the entire Wolf Carpenters team were great to work with. They recently completed a 7500 sf new construction office / warehouse building for me. Wolf performed all windows and door installation, framing, drywall interior finishes, flooring and painting. Everything was built with quality with attention to detail. The whole process was smooth and the Wolf team was ahead of schedule with all phases. I plan to build another building next year and will definitely be using this company for that project as well.

Wolf Carpenters are great! I recently had them repair damage in several rooms caused by a heating system leak and they did a wonderful job. In both rooms they replaced the subfloor and carpet, prepped and painted everything, repaired several and replaced one section of the baseboard heating system along with replacing the baseboard enclosures.
I would highly recommend them and I would certainly use them again. They do excellent work with their very skilled, professional, friendly, and hard working group of craftsmen. It was a pleasure having them in my home.

Rick Matthias

From our preliminary meetings with Julio, Gedson and Mauricio to completion we couldn't be happier. They truly care about every aspect of the job and were a pleasure to work with throughout our extensive project.

The project required gutting bathrooms, kitchen, walls, and replacing all doors. It was a complete re-imagining of the space.

The crew were always available and communication was excellent. We were impressed by their
follow through, trustworthiness, professionalism and punctuality.

The team adhered to the schedule, and nothing was ever too big of an ask. We found the team made up of talented craftsmen with great ideas who were caring, polite and respectful.

Each time we came up with an idea Gedson listened and researched our options. He presented us with a few solutions and made recommendations, always going the extra mile. He showed an attention to detail and wasn't happy until all things were done right and to his satisfaction.

Everyone was flexible and easy to work with, especially when we needed to make changes.

The final result exceeded our expectations.

Allan and I are grateful to the entire team at Wolf carpenters for helping to make a dream come true.

Thank you!

Great job! Keep you Lead happy. He's a gold mine! Awesome guy and worker.

You and your whole crew were very professional. I wanted to keep this project around $25,000. Your estimate came in a little bit more, but I feel I got my money's worth with the quality of the workmanship and the professionalism everyone displayed. They were never late, always respectful, and always left the worksite clean. I couldn't have asked for a better experience. My wife is ecstatic with the result.....which gets me points! 😁

We had an exceptional experience working with Wolf Carpenters, particularly Andy and his team, on our coffee and wine area. We had already finalized the design and cabinets that would complement our kitchen before reaching out to WC, and the final results surpassed our expectations. Every individual involved, from the cabinetry, countertops, electricity, and plumbing, demonstrated exceptional skill and attention to detail. They were also incredibly flexible and accommodating to any last-minute adjustments we requested. We are confident that Wolf Carpenters will be our go-to choice for any future projects.

We hired Wolf to complete a two-story addition (new kitchen, half bath, full bath and bedroom) on our 100+ year-old home— the entire experience exceeded our expectations. Their craftsmanship and attention to detail were exceptional, seamlessly blending the new addition with the original structure of our house. The level of skill and professionalism their team demonstrated throughout the project was truly impressive.

The project was completed on time and within budget, which speaks volumes about their organization and commitment. They communicated with clear timelines throughout the project. Their crew was hardworking, honest, respectful, and incredibly talented. Beyond their skills, they are genuinely good people — kind, trustworthy, and thoughtful in the way they treated both our home and our family.

Julio was transparent, professional, and easy to work with on the business side, while Gedson and Mauricio did an outstanding job managing the project from start to finish and handling every detail along the way. Communication was excellent throughout the renovation, and we always felt confident that everything was being handled with care.

We lived in the house throughout the renovation with our 3 very young kids, and their team consistently went above and beyond to keep the job site clean, organized, and safe each day. During the colder months, they even built temporary insulated walls to help keep the house comfortable. Their crew was considerate, patient, and understanding, which made what could have been a very stressful experience feel manageable.

What stood out most was their reliability and dedication — their team showed up every single day, on time, for six straight months. They took tremendous pride in their work, and it showed in every aspect of the project.

By the end of the renovation, they felt like part of our daily life, and we genuinely miss having their crew around. Wolf exceeded our expectations in every way, and we would highly recommend them to anyone looking for exceptional craftsmanship, professionalism, and truly good people to work with.
They did a great job thank you wolf . I recommend them
Excellent work. I was highly satisfied with the work. My condominium looks amazing. It was a pleasure working with wolfs painting and remodeling company.

I met Wolf Carpenters because they were hired by a roofing company I used to repair problems caused by the roofing company.
Wolf Carpenters showed up, identified issues and worked with my building department to remediate the issues caused by the roofing company.
They did such a great job that I hired them to install 3 skylight wells in 3 different rooms in my house. They worked well with engineers and the building department. Once they started the project they were able to finish quickly and did a very nice job. The end result is beautiful and we are very happy. I have many projects I plan to do in the future and would be happy to have Wolf back to help me.

I wanted to install 2 grab bars and a seat in my shower. I had problems finding someone until I found Wolf Carpenters. I quickly got an estimate which was reasonable and someone was sent to do the job in an acceptable period of time. The work was done within a day by a very pleasant young man and my wife and I are very pleased with the results. In addition to doing a very good job, the work area was left spotless. I highly recommend Wolf for your carpentry needs.

Read more

We hired Wolf Carpenters for a bathroom renovation recently. It was a total gut job, including window replacement, closet demo etc. Julio and his team were very professional and were able to give great recommendations for what would work within our timeline and vision. We are extremely happy with how the bathroom turned out and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing a bathroom renovation!

We have had a great experience. They provided valuable guidance, were always on time & did a beautiful job installing a new front door for an affordable price. I would highly recommend using this company.

Wolf Carpenters repaired siding on our home. We were very impressed with the level of skill of their team. All were very professional and polite. They did a fantastic job and we highly recommend them!

We used Wolf Construction to fix our deck and add ceiling access to our air conditioning unit. They were fantastic! The access panel ended up being a little more work than expected, but the end result was perfect. The ceiling looks great and they even added a fresh coat of paint to the wall. Highly recommend! Thank you Wolf Construction!

I can't say enough about how good the finished product is. A car hit our house, so we needed repairs to our siding. We also had broken stairs in the front and back of our house, so decided to have them all redone at the same time. Wolf came, gave a reasonable estimate, started the work in a timely manner, and made sure I was satisfied before leaving. Can't recommend them enough.

I highly recommend Wolf Carpenters Service!

Julio and Gedson are great with explanations and they have a lot of good ideias to do an outstanding service at my home!

They did an addition in my property and I’m very very happy with results!

The Crew are very nice, clean and professional, highly recommend.

There are no words to describe how grateful and satisfied I am with the service Wolf Carpenters did in my home. My kitchen turned out completely beautiful, just the way I had imagined. The team is great, everyone is very polite and friendly. I recommend their work 100% :)

I had a great experience with the Wolf team in building my office. They were professional, attentive, and delivered a high-quality result within the established timeframe. I am very satisfied with the service provided and highly recommend Wolf to anyone looking for a reliable company for construction projects.

Julio and his team are absolutely amazing. They created an all season porch for my parents from start to finish. They really brought to life what my parents envisioned and wanted. Julio was easy to communicate with, very responsive, a hard worker, and keeps his word when he says he’ll be there. We are so fortunate to have had Julio and Wolf Carpenters services!
